niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Udemy: *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a **psychological, Jungian approach to shadow work** or a **specific spiritual tradition**. A good starting shortlist:

### Shadow work
- **Jung Platform** — Best if you want a more grounded, Jungian route. Its courses focus on Jungian and post-Jungian methods, especially dreamwork and imaginal approaches. It’s a better fit for learning a framework than for a quick “shadow work certification.” [Browse courses](https://jungplatform.com/courses)
- **Udemy: *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self*** — A low-cost, self-paced introduction with exercises. The listing reports a 4.5/5 rating from 287 ratings, but treat the certificate as a completion badge, not a professional qualification. [Course page](https://www.udemy.com/course/shadow_work/)
- **Centre of Excellence: Shadow Mastery** — Another self-paced option with exercises. Consider it for structure and convenience; check the current syllabus, instructor background, and refund terms before buying. [Course page](https://www.centreofexcellence.com/shop/shadow-mastery-diploma-course/)

### Spiritual practice
- **Contemplative Outreach** — A strong choice if you’re interested in Christian contemplative practice, including Centering Prayer and related practices. [Course information](https://www.contemplativeoutreach.org/)
- **World Community for Christian Meditation (WCCM)** — Offers beginner-friendly courses on Christian meditation and building a regular practice; some are free. [Course information](https://wccm.org/)
- **Spirituality & Practice** — A broad catalog of self-guided and streamed courses across spiritual traditions, with options from introductory to more in-depth. [Course catalog](https://www.spiritualityandpractice.com/ecourses/course)
- **Sounds True** — A wide range of spirituality and meditation programs; useful if you prefer a teacher-led, audio/video format. [Browse spirituality courses](https://www.soundstrue.com/collections/spirituality)

**My practical recommendation:** Start with one introductory shadow-work course and one simple daily practice—such as meditation, prayer, or journaling—rather than taking several intensive courses at once. Shadow work can bring up difficult emotions, so choose a course that emphasizes pacing, grounding, and support. It isn’t a substitute for therapy; if you’re dealing with trauma or feeling overwhelmed, consider working with a licensed mental-health professional.
